lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Isabella Hunt is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Isabella Hunt is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Isabella kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Isabella's gone." Javier looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Isabella." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lucas blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Small Unit Tactics (Level 1). Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Isabella Hunt, 41 days. The mantle passes to Lucas Brown.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lucas Brown, 44 — a Police officer. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, War Cry.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Isabella — and Isabella is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Javier, Kathleen, Miguel and 5 more speak for Lucas — "Isabella trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Lucas before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
